capabilities: Collapse the properties area for the active file or all notes
Apply first-line indentation in source and reading mode
Hide configured folders from quick switcher results
Sync frontmatter title and updated fields on rename and modify
Rename local image attachments in note-body order
disambiguation: An assortment of eight unrelated tweaks rather than one editing tool; only some features touch editing.
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation is manual (copying into .obsidian/plugins); no community-store install steps are given. Some commands are Chinese-only UI labels.
intentEvidence: Hide files under configured folders from quick switcher results.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in options for collapsing properties across views, indenting first lines, filtering quick switcher results, or auto-syncing frontmatter fields on rename and modify.

relations.evidence: requires enabled Custom Attachment Location settings
writes the YAML boolean perlite_publish: true when the active note is unpublished
without requiring separate changes to Contextual Typography or Blue Topaz Custom

summary: Toolkit of small reading and editing tweaks: property collapsing, first-line indentation, quick switcher filtering, frontmatter sync, and image renaming.
